anna_sales: Heads-up: FinBank started the security questionnaire and flagged a requirement: offline delivery with customer-side re-signing (HSM). They also want a clear upgrade cadence and rollback story for the POC. Can we outline ops/price impacts?
priya_se: Quick tech note 1: we support delta vs full bundle. Deltas reduce USB size but add complexity (apply order, manifests, idempotency). For an airgapped K8s flow we usually provide a tarball + detached sig + manifest + sbom.
jordan_infra: From infra: blockers are reproducible builds, signed SBOM, and a deterministic installer. Also verify container runtime (they listed containerd 1.6) and k8s 1.25. Without egress we need manual image load steps or a local registry bootstrap.
mateo_cs: Support scope question: are they expecting 24x7 onsite for POC? That changes price a lot.
anna_sales: They said remote only for bootstrapping, but want a 6-week validation window followed by a 6-month observation period. Upgrade cadence: customer prefers no more than one update per 90 days during pilot.
security_team: Requirements from security: artifacts must include signed SBOM (CycloneDX) and provenance. They require detached signatures they can verify with their root key in HSM. Also want an audit log showing who applied what and when. Recommend a staging procedure: vendor builds -> vendor provides artifacts -> customer re-signs with HSM -> customer provides attest token.
priya_se: Re-sign options: we can (A) hand over unsigned artifacts + build recipe for customer to re-sign, (B) we sign and they re-sign, (C) build inside customer's validated builder (preferred but heavy). For POC we usually do A or B. If they want us to integrate with their HSM API that's a larger SOW.
jordan_infra: Practically, we can produce reproducible artifacts and a small helper script that performs cosign signing with a provided key. We'll also include manifest.sha256 and manifest.sig. The offline-installer will verify checksums and signatures before applying.
mateo_cs: Add rollback: offline-installer should snapshot current state and allow one-command rollback to previous artifact. We'll include runbook steps and a systemd unit to make apply idempotent.
anna_sales: Pricing asks: they want line items for (1) airgap bundle prep and validation (2) re-sign assist / attestation template (3) POC support for 6 months.
priya_se: Ballpark: bundle prep + SBOM/signing runbook = $7,500 one-time; re-sign assist + remote training = $2,500 one-time; POC support (24x5) $5,500/month. Onsite bootstrapping separately priced.
jordan_infra: Those ballpark figures align with estimated effort: 4-6 dev days + 2 SRE days for packaging and testing. If we need to certify against their exact kernel/container runtime matrix (multiple OS distros), that adds cost.
security_team: About upgrade cadence: we can do <=90 days but require a signed acceptance token from their QA after they run smoke tests post-apply. Without that token we will not push auto-updates. Also include a signed change log in the bundle.
anna_sales: Logistics: can we deliver via USB with a single verify command? They expect a simple operator flow.
priya_se: Yes. Typical layout: /artifacts/<artifact>.tar.gz, /artifacts/<artifact>.sig, /manifest.json, /sbom.json, /manifest.sha256. Verify example in runbook:

# verify
sha256sum -c manifest.sha256
cosign verify --key customer_pubkey.pem artifacts/artifact.tar.gz.sig
# apply
sudo ./offline-installer apply --bundle artifacts/artifact.tar.gz

We provide the offline-installer (static binary) and a systemd service to ensure idempotent applies.
mateo_cs: We'll include rollback: sudo ./offline-installer rollback --to previous-artifact-id. And a short checklist for staging on their hardened jumpbox to reduce USB risk.
deploybot: FYI build: rbw-oc-offline-20240918.tgz (sha256:3a7f...e1c9) staged at s3://redwood-airgap-staging/finbank/20240918/
priya_se: I'll pull that bundle and run local delta validation. Jordan, can you run compatibility smoke on k8s 1.25 + containerd 1.6?
jordan_infra: Sure. ETA EOD tomorrow; will post logs here.
security_team: I'll draft the security questionnaire responses and a short attestation template for the re-sign step. Also include SBOM sample (CycloneDX) and change log expectations.
anna_sales: Next steps: (1) Jordan runs smoke tests, (2) Priya validates delta/apply flow with the deploybot artifact, (3) Mateo drafts the staging handoff checklist and rollback runbook, (4) Security prepares questionnaire answers and attestation template. I'll schedule a FinBank handoff call Thu 10am PT. Can everyone make it?
priya_se: I can.
jordan_infra: Free.
mateo_cs: Free.
security_team: I'll join the first 20 mins.
anna_sales: I'll include the ballpark pricing in the invite so they can budget. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
